offence_note: Two counts sexual interference of stepdaughter; sexual assault counts stayed
sentence_quote: Count 1 - s. 151 - 7 years' imprisonment; 2. Count 2 - s. 151 - 7 years’ imprisonment to be served concurrently.
note: Orders inferred from agreed ancillary orders list, partly cut off; SOIRA assumed.

offence_note: Sexual interference, child pornography offences, breaches of release order
sentence_quote: The appellant seeks leave to appeal a global sentence of 11 years and 3 months, less credit for pre-sentence custody
note: Leave granted, appeal dismissed; includes 9 months Duncan credit in the 27-month count.

offence_note: Possession for trafficking; driving while disqualified
sentence_quote: Counsel have agreed that the sentence of incarceration should have been 556 days, which reflected time served plus one day, for possession for the purpose of trafficking, concurrent to the two years for the drive while disqualified
note: Consecutive sentences made concurrent; victim surcharge removed; credit computed as 2 years minus 174 days.

offence_note: Rape and sexual assault of two nieces
sentence_quote: On the count of rape, I sentence you, Mr. Crabe, to a period of incarceration of two years less a day.
note: Eight months concurrent on sexual assault; conditional sentence rejected.

offence_note: Assaults, threats, mischief, obstruct justice, breaches; dangerous offender
sentence_quote: We would not disturb the sentencing judge’s imposition of an indeterminate sentence.
note: Conviction and dangerous offender appeal dismissed.

offence_note: Possession of child pornography for purpose of distribution
sentence_quote: The sentencing judge disagreed with the defence submission and imposed a nine month jail term to be followed by two years probation.
note: Other mitigating factor: voluntary removal of material. Leave granted, appeal dismissed.

sentence_quote: After a sentencing hearing spanning two days, Mr. Justice Butler set Mr. Singh's period of parole ineligibility at 16 years.
note: Guilty plea on eve of trial; mitigation not discussed in appeal reasons.

offence_note: Conspiracy to commit murder (planned mass shooting)
sentence_quote: I impose a sentence of 10 years imprisonment. He is to be given credit for 974 days calculated as the time in custody multiplied by 1.5
note: Joint recommendation accepted; firearms prohibition for life.

offence_note: Uttering threats and multiple breaches of court orders
sentence_quote: This will reduce the effective sentence to 15 months, which, with credit for time served prior to sentencing, will leave a custodial sentence of eight months.
note: Ten charges; some offences not fully shown. Probation conditions modified. Credit inferred from 15 less 8 months.
Crown appeal allowed in principle; sentence to be set after further submissions; mandatory minimum struck.
